neutral.label: Neutral
neutral.blurb: Neither a buff nor a debuff.

crit-up.label: Crit Up
crit-up.blurb: Increases critical rate or critical damage.

ignore-defense.label: Ignore Defense
ignore-defense.blurb: Ignores a portion of the target's defense.

healing.label: Healing
healing.blurb: Restores HP or improves healing received.

crit-down.label: Crit Down
crit-down.blurb: Reduces critical rate or critical damage.

stability-damage-down.label: Stability Damage Down
stability-damage-down.blurb: Reduces stability damage dealt or taken protection.

dot.label: Damage over Time
dot.blurb: Deals damage at the start/end of a turn or action.

uncleansable.label: Uncleansable
uncleansable.blurb: Cannot be cleansed, dispelled, or removed.

immunity.label: Immunity
immunity.blurb: Grants immunity to some effect or damage.

summon.label: Summon
summon.blurb: A summoned unit or summon-related effect.
